title: pvCurvature
body:
## pvCurvature

Generated binding of ParaView's Curvature filter: computes per-point Gaussian (ParaView default) or mean curvature of a polygonal surface into the point array Gauss_Curvature or Mean_Curvature. Gaussian curvature is positive on sphere-like and negative on saddle-like regions (units 1/length²); mean curvature (1/length) assumes outward normals. Use the curated curvature (Schemaxis default Mean) for the usual case; this binding defaults to Gaussian.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Volume meshes are rejected; extract the surface first (surface or pvExtractSurface).
- Results are noisy on coarse or poorly shaped triangulations; smooth or refine first.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Curvature`. Identity: `filters/Curvatures`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Curvature filter. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CurvatureType` | This property specifies which type of curvature to compute. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Gaussian","Mean"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Gaussian"` |
| `InvertMeanCurvature` | If this property is set to 1, the mean curvature calculation will be inverted. This is useful for meshes with inward-pointing normals. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvCurvature",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
